title: Genshin Impact Lunar Expansion
description: It is a massive expansion that brings the magic, weaponry, and currencies of Teyvat into Minecraft, while completely overhauling your end-game exploration with breathtaking new biomes, mystical abilities, and custom entities.
body:
# **Genshin Impact Lunar Expansion (GILE beta)**

_Please note: GILE is currently in Beta. Features, balancing, and mechanics are subject to change! There is a lot to come and for newer versions._

## 🌟 Teyvat Meets Minecraft

Bring the thrill of wishes and elemental power to your survival world. GileMod introduces a comprehensive currency and legendary weapon system.

## 🪙 Currencies & Materials

- Primogems: Mine Primogem Ore (found in the Overworld and The End) to collect Minecraft's newest valuable resource.
- Mora: The universal currency is now at your fingertips. Used to trade with Weasels and craft elemental sigils.
- Elemental Sigils: Collect Anemo, Geo, Electro, Dendro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, and the custom Luna Sigils.
- Wish Crafting: Forge Wish Nuggets and Wish Ingots, or place a decorative Wish block to show off your wealth. Fate weapon set - bow, arrow and sword - is an upgrade to netherite.

## ⚔️ Legendary Weapons (WIP)

Wield the signature weapons of your favorite characters. These unbreakable artifacts boast custom attributes and high-tier damage profiles.

![GILE weapons description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab86e5aa69629e760e199b94751cb8377e11200e.png)

## 🌑 The Expanded End Dimension

The End is no longer just barren islands. GileMod breathes atmospheric life into the void with two brand-new biomes and a suite of building materials.

## 🌳 New Biomes

- Ghostly Thickets: A hauntingly beautiful highland biome featuring End Grass, towering Ghostly Trees with lavender leaves, cloud blobs, and real physical stars scattered across the sky.
- Moon Desert: A desolate, otherworldly landscape covered in Moon Sand and Dry Flowers.

## 🧱 New Building Blocks

- Ghostly Wood Set: A complete, craftable wood set (Logs, Planks, Stairs, Slabs, Fences, Signs, Trapdoors, and more) made from the eerie Ghostly Trees.
Pearlescent Blocks: Craft stunning, high-tier structures using Pearlescent Blocks, Bricks, Slabs, Stairs, Walls, and Chains.
- Moon Sand & Sandstone: Smooth, cut, and chiseled variants for your lunar builds.
- Light Sources: Illuminate your base with Stars, Moon Torches, Moon Lanterns, and Moon Campfires.

## ✨ Mystical Tools & Abilities

GileMod isn't just about what you swing; it's about how you move and interact with the world.

- Grappling Hook: Traverse the jagged cliffs or the End islands with ease.
Fate Bow & Fate Arrows: A powerful ranged weapon that interacts with custom Fate Arrows.
- Shadow Clock & Heart of Healing: Unique utility items to aid your survival. Regen your HP when it's really low and tp wherever you need at little cost.
- Shrinker & Enlarger: Wield these custom wands to access active abilities*!
  - Shrink Ability: Toggle infinite Invisibility on and off at will when shrinked to 20% of your size to be able to hide wherever no one else can!
  - Enlarge Ability: Unleash a devastating area-of-effect slam that damages, knocks back, and slows surrounding enemies while enlarged to 180% of your initial size to travel faster, damage stronger and be healthier. It can help you with big building projects and tree chopping too!

*(Shrink and enlarge when holding the corresponding wand by right click to emit a ray on others, or on shift right click for yourself. You can also cancel the effect on entites by right clicking them when those are near and on yourself by shift right click looking straight down. Applying opposite effects cancels them too. Can be accumulated. Toggle abilities on V keybind by default, can be configured in your game options.)

## 🦋 New Creatures & Mobs

Populate your world with a diverse cast of custom entities, ranging from ambient life to new threats.

- Void Slimes: Bouncy, dangerous monstrosities found lurking in the End biomes.
- Moths: Fluttering creatures drawn to light, dropping Moth Wings.
- Weasel Thieves: Mischievous Overworld critters with 3 tiers of rarity with coherent items to trade. Could work really well on a skyblock map, providing a lot of materials that are unobtainable there!
- Jerboas: Small desert-dwellers found hopping across the Moon Desert and regular sandy biomes.
- Gloomy Lynx: A majestic, elusive predator prowling the Ghostly Thickets.
- Luminous & Hovering Ghosts: Ambient, ghostly entities that add a magical atmosphere to the Thickets. Hovering Ghosts can help you to travel over the void too as can be rided with a saddle when tamed.

## 🔥 Custom Mechanics & Foods

- Moon Fire: Ignite Moon Sand using a Flint & Steel to create a distinct, eerie magenta flame.
- New Consumables: Survive the harsh dimensions by snacking on Jelly, Jam, Cooked Phasma, and the high-saturation "Offering" (which grants temporary Slow Falling!).
- Custom Advancements: A somewhat quest/guide-line to help you progress with the mod.

## ⚙️ Installation & Requirements

- Modloader: Fabric
- Dependencies: Fabric API (0.19.2 or newer for minecraft 1.21.1)
- Version: Minecraft 1.21.1 (will be updated)

================================================================================

_This is a Beta release. There is already a list of known issues that will be fixed on later releases:_

## ⚠️ Known Issues

- Zoom is not working on bows
- Mending and Unbreaking are not enchantable on bows
- "Monster Hunter" advancement does not grant for killing modded monsters
- Ghostly hanging signs are not showing the correct GUI
- If Nocturne's Curtain Call is gone from the inventory too fast, low gravity attribute could stay
- Map colors for most modded blocks are not correct
- Fire aspect on custom weapons does not cook meat
- Every elemental weapon will be highly upgraded later to match better their characters
- Weasel Thiefs spawn is cursed, sometimes only one time after the world creation. Some of their trades are susceptable to change later
- Grapling hook can sometimes disfunction and can't be enchanted for now as well as jelly on a stick and wands

<summary>Accessibility Text Description</summary>

  Image 1: Overall Mod Preview

The image showcases many of the blocks, items, entities, and environmental features added by Genshin Impact Lunar Expansion. The scene takes place inside the End dimension and displays a purple and pale-colored landscape of Ghostly Thickets biome. Several Ghostly Trees with gray trunks and lavender foliage surround the area. Clouds and physical stars are visible in the sky. Mod adds also a Moon Desert biome, consisted entirely of Moon Sand, Moon Sandstone and Dry Flowers.

A large display wall presents many of the mod's collectibles and equipment. These include elemental sigils corresponding to Anemo, Geo, Electro, Dendro, Hydro, Pyro, Cryo, and Luna. Beneath them are numerous legendary weapons inspired by Genshin Impact characters, along with materials, tools utility items, and accessories. Tools are made basically to ensure an easier way to travel through the End but not only. Among them:
Shadow Clock can save and use warp points to teleport. Grappling Hook acts as expected. Heart of Healing regenerates player's health when low. Jelly on a Stick is used to ride Hovering Ghosts. Shrinker and Enlarger wands apply or substract new custom corresponding effects.

Visible building materials include Pearlescent block, Pearlescent chains, stairs, slabs, Moon Sand, Moon Sandstone variants, and other construction and decoration blocks. Several light sources as moon fire, torch, lantern and campfire are displayed in the foreground, together with flowers and plants found in the new biomes.

Several custom creatures and decorative entities are shown above the display wall, representing every new life form added by the mod. Ambient Hovering Ghosts that can be ridden and cute Luminous just wandering in Ghostly Thickets. Hostile Gloomy Lynx hunts them. Void Slime can spawn anywhere in the End dimension and pushes player on hit. Moth and Jerboa are able to also spawn in the Overworld. Weasel Thieves have 3 tiers of rarity, influencing their trades, and spawn only in the Overworld (have some spawning issues actually and trades might be seriously rebalanced).

  Image 2: Legendary Weapons and Their Abilities

Daybreak Chronicles (inspired by Venti):
Fires unlimited fast arrows that push any enemy away.

Vortex Vanquisher (inspired by Zhongli):
Immobilizes enemies.

Engulfing Lightning (inspired by Raiden Shogun):
Summons lightning strikes during melee combat.

Thousand Floating Dreams (inspired by Nahida):
Poisons enemies.

Splendor of Tranquil Waters (inspired by Furina):
Allows underwater breathing and increased regeneration.

Thousand Blazing Suns (inspired by Mavuika):
Sets enemies on fire and grants higher movement speed in water too.

Tsaritsa's Scepter (inspired by Tsaritsa):
Allows walking and jumping on water to travel across oceans.

Nocturne's Curtain Call (inspired by Columbina):
Reduces gravity and lifts the hit mob into the air.

  These weapon abilitiess are currently work in progress and may change in future versions.

Requires Fabric API for minecraft 1.21.1
</details>

If you find any other bugs or have balancing suggestions, please leave a comment right here!

P.S. If you need any help for the recipes or uses of any item from the mod, just install WAILA and JEI mods, see more on their official pages.

Good luck in adventuring with the GILE mod and thanks for reading!
